findings: All 15 pixel captures succeeded; one wrong-bundle enumeration and two strict whole-display geometry requests were rejected before capture.
Same exact paused 20s sourcePTS/generation/revision/contentKind2/rate0 held before and after every capture.
Native full fixture is dark while PiP contains an enlarged red/green subregion. SDR and HDR controls reproduce this geometry discrepancy; no product cause assigned.
PiP independent and target-only display captures are identical over 372624 opaque pixels in the shared 880x490 ROI; 58576 nonopaque pixels excluded.
All HDR buffers carry the same DisplayP3 ICC, surface headroom1 and no RGB above1; later captures report NSScreen current/potential EDR16.
Source-frame identity comes from independently sampled application state, not screenshot samplePTS.
No alpha mode or absolute reference-white-nits value supplied; no HDR preservation, physical brightness, wide-gamut accuracy, geometry equivalence or scanout qualification.
